race.comment: BUTTERCUP (10) is desperate to break through, with her 1000m record a major asset and Rodd staying aboard is a plus. She was favourite when fifth behind at Eagle Farm on heavy ground, and her previous second at this track behind Terrax reads very well for a Mdn of this shape. Weight relief strengthens the case even further. Ready. TILLYS LAST WISH (15) is a Written Tycoon mare on debut for the Kendricks and has shown enough in her lead-up work to suggest she can make a bright start. FAT BARRY (2) resumes for the Jimmy Downes stable after three trials, including a close second at Deagon, and his Port Macquarie second to Aerofoil gives him a genuine fresh chance if he is ready over 1000m. VAREJAO (5) has been close in two recent runs here, backs up quickly and brings enough consistency to be a live danger.
